constellations.desc: When in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
constellations.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.
constellations.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke

constellations.desc: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.
constellations.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part

constellations.desc:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, the beam becomes a more powerful <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> attack deals 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.
constellations.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn

passives.desc: {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: When using the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11332}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis</color>{/LINK}, if Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.\nAdditionally, for every 10 points of <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Refined Tactics</color> for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.
passives.name: Eternal Speculation Engine

passives.desc: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.
passives.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct

passives.desc: Sandrone will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Light of Rationalisme

passives.desc: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.
passives.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "<color=#FFD780FF>Fagio</color>," and switches it to <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The condensed beams will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode when its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> has decreased to under 50.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition

skills.desc:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the <color=#FFD780FF>Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech</color> and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The second Prism Shot will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> to swiftly decrease.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis

skills.desc: In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.\n{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.

const2.description: <color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>：重击发射的冷凝射线的暴击伤害提升40%，且每次发射冷凝射线时，都会使本次<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式期间，发射的所有冷凝射线的暴击伤害进一步提升20%，该效果至多叠加3层。

const3.description: 普通攻击{LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·自明演绎</color>{/LINK}的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const3.name: 不叹日落，不羡月升

const4.description: 桑多涅的星超导/星扩散反应伤害命中敌人时，还会额外召唤一台棱晶谐振炮进行协同攻击，对敌人造成一次相当于桑多涅攻击力125%/187.5%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，该伤害视为对应星烁反应造成的伤害。该效果每4秒至多触发一次。
const4.name: 世事皆数，昼来夜往

const5.description: 元素爆发{LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·万理证毕</color>{/LINK}的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
const5.name: 万象皆灰，唯理明畅

const6.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式下，法洁欧第三次发射冷凝射线时，将转为持续发射威力更强的<color=#FFD780FF>集束型冷凝射线</color>，在原本后续发射的冷凝射线基础上，至多额外造成4段相当于桑多涅攻击力100%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>集束型冷凝射线</color>转为至多额外造成4段视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，该伤害相当于桑多涅攻击力的：
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：80%；
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：120%。
此外，桑多涅造成的所有星烁反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}20%。
const6.name: 水仙梦醒，且望晨光

hyperlinks.description: 进行重击时，法洁欧将会切换至该模式。\n处于该模式下时，法洁欧会对前方的敌人进行扫射攻击，并周期性发射冷凝射线，造成冰元素范围伤害。\n辉映·星超导：冷凝射线转为造成视为星超导反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 解算

hyperlinks.description: 处于解算模式下时，法洁欧的解算功率会不断上升；解算功率达到上限时，将无法维持或重新进入解算模式。
hyperlinks.name: 解算功率

hyperlinks.description: 触发星超导反应时，附近的区域会短暂变化为极星辉域；处于极星辉域中时，特定角色将会进入辉映·星超导状态，使其不同技能分别获得对应的强化效果。
hyperlinks.name: 极星辉域

hyperlinks.description: 辉映·星超导与辉映·星扩散统称为辉映·星烁状态。\n角色同时只能受到一种辉映状态影响，且优先被辉映·星超导影响。
hyperlinks.name: 辉映·星烁

info.description: 愚人众执行官第七席，「木偶」。以数理解析事象之人，茶会上永不缺席的优雅淑女。
info.name: 桑多涅
info.title: 镜水析谬

p1.description: {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：施放元素战技{LINK#S11332}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·游衍解析</color>{/LINK}时，若法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}</color>超过50点，则会在降低解算功率的同时，使向附近敌人发射的第二枚棱晶弹造成原本400%的伤害。\n此外，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>解算功率</color>每降低10点，都会获得一层持续60秒的<color=#FFD780FF>改进战术</color>效果，该效果至多叠加10层。桑多涅处于<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>状态下施放元素爆发{LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·万理证毕</color>{/LINK}时，将会清除全部的改进战术层数，使负温聚能光束造成原本100%+清除层数*10%的伤害。
p1.name: 悠久的演算机关

p2.description: 基于桑多涅的攻击力，提升其元素精通：每100点攻击力都将使桑多涅的元素精通提升8点，至多通过这种方式提升160点元素精通。
p2.name: 淑女的行事准则

p3.description: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，桑多涅将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于桑多涅的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.7%星超导和星扩散反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。
p3.name: 星耀祝礼·唯理为光

p4.description: 桑多涅处于队伍中时，向凯瑟琳交付每日委托任务后，会获得额外的茶点奖励。
p4.name: 茶会的序曲与长长的故事

elementalburst.description: 秉持淑女优雅的礼仪，召唤出大量棱晶谐振炮对前方进行广域轰炸，并在随后发射负温聚能光束轰击敌人，造成冰元素范围伤害。 {LINK#N11500004}辉映·星烁{/LINK}：负温聚能光束将转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的冰元素范围伤害。 「只要能给出严谨的证明，我就会相信。要是不能，那就先将其证明。」 「这便是淑女的礼仪。屈服于未知的意志薄弱之人，又怎么能称得上是淑女呢？」
elementalburst.name: 事象数式·万理证毕

elementalskill.description: 秉持淑女完美的法度，搭乘茶会用战术突击悬浮机关，并持续向前浮行6秒。期间，桑多涅可以控制浮行的方向，并且点按冲刺时，将会消耗10点体力，进入优雅的高速悬浮模式，每秒消耗15点体力，以更快的速度进行浮行。 开始浮行时，若附近存在敌人，桑多涅还会召唤出一台棱晶谐振炮，向没有冷静下来的敌人发射两枚棱晶弹，造成冰元素伤害。 {LINK#N11500004}辉映·星烁{/LINK}：第二枚棱晶弹将转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的冰元素伤害。 搭乘茶会用战术突击悬浮机关时，桑多涅还会优雅地悄悄维修法洁欧，使其{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}快速降低。 齿轮传动的扭矩，胎海凝冰的相点，夜歌轻扬的频率，万古的潮汐与月升月落的法则，事象皆屈从于数式可解析的定理。 「那么我们不妨承认——我们必须承认，我们的神明、希望与爱，同样可被理性所定义。」
elementalskill.name: 事象数式·游衍解析

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
以数式编织出操纵兵刃的丝线，进行至多三段的连续挥砍。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
召唤出全功能通用型自动机关<color=#FFD780FF>「法洁欧」</color>，并使其切换至<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式：对前方的敌人进行扫射攻击，并周期性发射冷凝射线，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：冷凝射线转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
在<color=#FFD780FF>解算</color>模式下，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}</color>将会持续提升；发射冷凝射线时，还会使解算功率进一步提升。
解算功率达到100点上限时，法洁欧将切换至<color=#FFD780FF>功率过载</color>模式，以更长的间隔对敌人进行射击，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，且无法切换至解算模式。
不处于<color=#FFD780FF>解算</color>模式下时，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>解算功率</color>将会缓慢降低；桑多涅处于队伍后台时，还会专注于维修法洁欧，使其解算功率降低速度加快至原本的300%。
<color=#FFD780FF>解算功率</color>降低至50点以下时，法洁欧将退出<color=#FFD780FF>功率过载</color>模式。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 事象数式·自明演绎

constellations.desc: When in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
constellations.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.
constellations.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke

constellations.desc: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.
constellations.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part

constellations.desc:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode, the beam becomes a more powerful <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Condensed Cluster Beam</color> attack deals 4 additional instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 20%.
constellations.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn

passives.desc: {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: When using the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11332}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis</color>{/LINK}, if Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.\nAdditionally, for every 10 points of <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Refined Tactics</color> for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst {LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.</color>{/LINK} while in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.
passives.name: Eternal Speculation Engine

passives.desc: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.
passives.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct

passives.desc: Sandrone will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
passives.name: Light of Rationalisme

passives.desc: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.
passives.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "<color=#FFD780FF>Fagio</color>," and switches it to <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}Decoding{/LINK}</color> mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The condensed beams will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
While in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding</color> mode, Fagio's <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits <color=#FFD780FF>Power Overdrive</color> mode when its <color=#FFD780FF>Decoding Power</color> has decreased to under 50.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition

skills.desc:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the <color=#FFD780FF>Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech</color> and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color>.
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The second Prism Shot will instead deal <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}Decoding Power{/LINK}</color> to swiftly decrease.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis

skills.desc: In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.\n{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK}: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
skills.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.

constellations.desc: 处于<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式下时，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}</color>提升速度降低50%，且队伍中的所有角色造成的星烁反应伤害提升30%。
constellations.name: 鎏金未凋，夕暮已远

constellations.desc: <color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>：重击发射的冷凝射线的暴击伤害提升40%，且每次发射冷凝射线时，都会使本次<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式期间，发射的所有冷凝射线的暴击伤害进一步提升20%，该效果至多叠加3层。
constellations.name: 回望镜中，时岁翩然

constellations.desc: 普通攻击{LINK#S11331}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·自明演绎</color>{/LINK}的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 不叹日落，不羡月升

constellations.desc: 桑多涅的星超导/星扩散反应伤害命中敌人时，还会额外召唤一台棱晶谐振炮进行协同攻击，对敌人造成一次相当于桑多涅攻击力125%/187.5%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，该伤害视为对应星烁反应造成的伤害。该效果每4秒至多触发一次。
constellations.name: 世事皆数，昼来夜往

constellations.desc: 元素爆发{LINK#S11335}<color=#FFD780FF>事象数式·万理证毕</color>{/LINK}的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 万象皆灰，唯理明畅

constellations.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式下，法洁欧第三次发射冷凝射线时，将转为持续发射威力更强的<color=#FFD780FF>集束型冷凝射线</color>，在原本后续发射的冷凝射线基础上，至多额外造成4段相当于桑多涅攻击力100%的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>：<color=#FFD780FF>集束型冷凝射线</color>转为至多额外造成4段视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>，该伤害相当于桑多涅攻击力的：
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>：80%；
<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>：120%。
此外，桑多涅造成的所有星烁反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}20%。
constellations.name: 水仙梦醒，且望晨光

passives.name: 悠久的演算机关

passives.desc: 基于桑多涅的攻击力，提升其元素精通：每100点攻击力都将使桑多涅的元素精通提升8点，至多通过这种方式提升160点元素精通。
passives.name: 淑女的行事准则

passives.desc: 处于{LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>极星辉域</color>{/LINK}中时/队伍中的角色在附近触发星扩散反应后的8秒内，桑多涅将分别进入<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星超导</color>/<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星扩散</color>状态。\n队伍中的角色触发超导/冰扩散反应时，将转为触发星超导/星扩散反应，且基于桑多涅的攻击力，提升队伍中角色造成的上述反应的基础伤害：每100点攻击力都将提升0.7%星超导和星扩散反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。
passives.name: 星耀祝礼·唯理为光

passives.desc: 桑多涅处于队伍中时，向凯瑟琳交付每日委托任务后，会获得额外的茶点奖励。
passives.name: 茶会的序曲与长长的故事

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
以数式编织出操纵兵刃的丝线，进行至多三段的连续挥砍。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
召唤出全功能通用型自动机关<color=#FFD780FF>「法洁欧」</color>，并使其切换至<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330001}解算{/LINK}</color>模式：对前方的敌人进行扫射攻击，并周期性发射冷凝射线，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：冷凝射线转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
在<color=#FFD780FF>解算</color>模式下，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}</color>将会持续提升；发射冷凝射线时，还会使解算功率进一步提升。
解算功率达到100点上限时，法洁欧将切换至<color=#FFD780FF>功率过载</color>模式，以更长的间隔对敌人进行射击，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>，且无法切换至解算模式。
不处于<color=#FFD780FF>解算</color>模式下时，法洁欧的<color=#FFD780FF>解算功率</color>将会缓慢降低；桑多涅处于队伍后台时，还会专注于维修法洁欧，使其解算功率降低速度加快至原本的300%。
<color=#FFD780FF>解算功率</color>降低至50点以下时，法洁欧将退出<color=#FFD780FF>功率过载</color>模式。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中下坠冲击地面，攻击下落路径上的敌人，并在落地时造成范围伤害。
skills.name: 事象数式·自明演绎

skills.desc:
秉持淑女完美的法度，搭乘<color=#FFD780FF>茶会用战术突击悬浮机关</color>，并持续向前浮行6秒。期间，桑多涅可以控制浮行的方向，并且点按冲刺时，将会消耗10点体力，进入优雅的高速悬浮模式，每秒消耗15点体力，以更快的速度进行浮行。

开始浮行时，若附近存在敌人，桑多涅还会召唤出一台棱晶谐振炮，向没有冷静下来的敌人发射两枚棱晶弹，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>。
{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：第二枚棱晶弹将转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素伤害</color>。

搭乘茶会用战术突击悬浮机关时，桑多涅还会优雅地悄悄维修法洁欧，使其<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11330002}解算功率{/LINK}</color>快速降低。
skills.name: 事象数式·游衍解析

skills.desc: 秉持淑女优雅的礼仪，召唤出大量棱晶谐振炮对前方进行广域轰炸，并在随后发射负温聚能光束轰击敌人，造成<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。\n{LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>辉映·星烁</color>{/LINK}：负温聚能光束将转为造成视为对应星烁反应伤害的<color=#99FFFFFF>冰元素范围伤害</color>。
skills.name: 事象数式·万理证毕
